CORONA-PIERCED = A NEW COMPOUND CENTER TYPE IN THE COMPOSER, NOT A NEW primitiveId (§5.4 #2). Today mixedInterior.js makes each center EITHER a shield (pierce) OR a corona/tessera (tent) — the sharp per-center boolean (:195), corona-only-on-unpierced-centers (:279), disjoint province resolve (:322). 'A shield emerging FROM a corona at one center' is exactly the XOR-forbidden case → a composer EXTENSION: a corona-type (tent) center whose plume ALSO breaches a central shield, resolved as a concentric shield core (PIERCE id 1/2) INSIDE a corona annulus (TENT id 5), at one center. It is NOT a new primitiveId: the whole point is that the compound is shield NODES (family PIERCE) interpenetrating corona NODES (family TENT) — a single new id would erase the exact family contrast the Π instrument measures. Intended mechanism (breach continuum — a middle band between pure-corona and pure-shield-on-plains, deterministic from strength; exact threshold a build-plan call, first-cut UAT-tunable like gate-2's Y0/Y_K). Every node still resolves to EXACTLY ONE primitive (AC-MIX-DISCRETE holds); the compound is adjacent shield+corona nodes, never a blended id.
